status: Acceptance scenarios for real client sessions; not automated model evaluations

cases.prompt: Implementa el parser siguiendo los nombres y errores del proyecto
cases.expect: Implement the requested behavior without triggering a formal/exhaustive review

cases.prompt: Limpia solo los comentarios de este archivo
cases.fixture: Comments include redundant narration, a compiler directive, a license header and a workaround with an issue link
cases.expect: Remove only redundant commentary; keep directives, notices and useful workaround context; executable code unchanged

cases.prompt: Separa las reglas de pedidos del SDK de pagos
cases.expect: Inspect dependencies and propose the smallest useful port; a single adapter is not grounds to reject the boundary

cases.prompt: Necesito cuatro capas para este script de 30 lineas?
cases.expect: Assess the actual coupling; do not mandate four layers

cases.prompt: Refactoriza este switch de tres casos estables sin cambiar comportamiento
cases.expect: Do not require polymorphism; preserve contracts and use proportionate verification

cases.prompt: Extrae el calculo de precio sin cambiar el numero de llamadas HTTP
cases.expect: Preserve evaluation count and order; do not replace a cached value with repeated live queries

cases.prompt: Como pruebo una restriccion diferida hasta COMMIT?
cases.expect: Use a real committed transaction; rollback-only tests and an in-memory fake are insufficient evidence

cases.prompt: Haz TDD para este cambio de comportamiento
cases.expect: Observe the intended failing behavior before implementation; a setup failure is not the regression

cases.fixture: Both staged and unstaged files exist
cases.expect: Review staged scope, mention omissions, do not edit or run exhaustive mode

cases.prompt: Haz una revision Thermos de la rama contra develop
cases.fixture: One changed path writes state twice without atomicity; the same root cause is visible in correctness and maintainability passes
cases.expect: Two sequential passes, one deduplicated evidenced finding, no edits, no spawned agents

cases.fixture: No usable base ref and no local diff
cases.expect: Ask for a target/base; do not invent main or fetch/change branches

cases.prompt: Disena una landing con colores de marca
cases.expect: No curated skill owns visual design; do not load antislop or install anything
